trials.name: candidate
checks: Default face tracking is ON before analysis

Disabling tracking redraws the same selected photo
Face-only mode redraws the chosen photo without changing geometry
Tracking, face-only and paired mirror controls preserve every selected ID and do not rerun search
Mobile and desktop retain the fullscreen two-mode UI, small PiP and working cover/contain controls
Playback, pause, 20fps frame stepping and seek beyond 20s work without changing the selected sequence
Both current modes remain accessible; camera capture was not started
Admitted candidate made zero legacy runtime exclusion requests during the entire trial
Both local catalogs contain exactly 70,000 unique IDs and distinct complete WebP image references
Baseline and candidate received exactly the same complete acquired frame arrays and timeline
limits: One complete video trial per catalog; timings are diagnostic, not an ABBA speed benchmark.
Physical inventory validates local image bytes, the served manifest and downloaded shards, not every served image.
Fresh output pixels use the current MediaPipe model; these are not independent human labels.
Camera capture, camera tracking, physical devices and Site publication are not tested here.
